name: UFO
summary: Flying saucer with a glass dome and blinking lights, in front view; optional tractor beam. For sci-fi scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the saucer stands on y; it hovers in the air

params.name: s
params.note: scale: about 940 px wide and 340 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: fly = hovers and the lights blink in turn

params.name: beam
params.note: show a glowing tractor beam down from the saucer

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (the saucer is symmetric; mainly for the beam)

author: krakujs
